removal.rule: A removal undoes the recorded operations, taking files and server entries before the directories that held them and a deeper directory before a shallower one, and stops at anything whose digest no longer matches what was written. A directory is deleted only when it is empty, and a server entry only when no other recorded installation on this host still names the same document and entry.
removal.guard: The digest of what was written, recorded against the exact path and entry. An installation refuses to replace a file or a server entry this host did not write, and a removal leaves anything that changed since.
removal.record_location: the host's own state directory, under agent-tools/
removal.shared_documents: A document more than one agent reads carries an entry identical whichever installation wrote it, and no per-agent tool deadline, because those agents do not share a spelling. It is removed only when no other recorded installation on this host still names the same document and entry.
